jobs.notes: Scheme-wide window: applications open 9am AEST Wed 9 June 2027, but the Law Society publishes two permitted closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) with each participating firm choosing one, so a single confirmed close date cannot be given; eligibility is generally penultimate-year students.
